summary: First-time end-to-end testing of ALI Workspace (Trello-like). Backend: 27/27 pytest tests passed covering auth, boards/seed, work-items CRUD/move, claim, submit+approve, mirror/unmirror, archive, checklist, comment+mention+notification, attachment upload, RBAC, search, automation rule (card_moved → add_label), admin panel (users/divisions/activities), and seed integrity (Nusantara submitted, Graha mirrored). Frontend: login (success + error toast), dashboard (Pekerjaan Aktif 18, workload per divisi & user), sidebar navigation to boards, board columns (PRATINJAU/FU NOTARIS) with card tiles rendering labels/due dates/PIC avatars/checklist progress, card modal (title, description, checklist w/ 50% progress, comments w/ @mention highlighted, activity tab, mirror/archive actions), notifications bell, global search (Graha), MyWork, AllWork (403 for staff, works for admin), AdminPanel tabs, Otomasi modal all functional. Elis claim flow works via UI (button toggles to 'Lepas Pekerjaan' after claim).

issues: React console warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)'. Non-blocking but indicates setState called during render in /app/frontend/src/pages/Login (likely navigate() inside a render path, should be wrapped in useEffect).

Initial WS connect gets 401/closed on the /login page before token exists (WebSocket connection to wss://.../api/ws failed: closed before connection established). After login it reconnects successfully. Suggest gating WS connect on auth-ready state to avoid noisy console errors.

action_items: (Low) Fix Login setState-in-render warning by moving redirect logic into useEffect in /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx
(Low) Gate RealtimeContext WebSocket connect on presence of access token / user to avoid 401 WS close on /login
